name: Model Melissa
source:
Melissa has been struggling to earn a living on just a part time job at the local resort. Fortunately perhaps she was spotted by a talent agent looking for models whilst out in town one day.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1160580/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
梅丽莎一直在当地度假村靠一份兼职工作谋生。幸运的是，也许有一天她在城里外出时被一位寻找模特的经纪人发现了。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1160580/]Steam[/url]]
